description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans' code-generated serializers, verifying serialization and deserialization of various types, including classes, records, structs, arrays, collections, and external types, with a focus on high-performance, reference preservation, and schema evolution support.

classes.name: GeneratedSerializerTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying Orleans' source-generated serializers, including tests for class, record, array, collection, and external type serialization, as well as reference preservation and schema evolution.

methods.name: GeneratedSerializersRoundTripThroughCodec
methods.description: Serializes and deserializes an object using the codec, verifying data integrity.

methods.name: GeneratedRecordSerializersRoundTripThroughCodec
methods.description: Tests serialization of C# record types, ensuring constructor and property data are preserved.

methods.name: AutoGeneratedPublicPropertyIdsTest
methods.description: Verifies auto-generated property IDs for serialization.

methods.name: RecursiveTypeSerializersRoundTripThroughSerializer
methods.description: Tests serialization of recursive object graphs with reference preservation.

methods.name: RecursiveTypeSerializersRoundTripThroughCodec
methods.description: Tests serialization of recursive object graphs with reference preservation using codec.

methods.name: GeneratedRecordWithPCtorSerializersRoundTripThroughCodec
methods.description: Tests serialization of record types with primary constructors.

methods.name: GeneratedLibExternalRecordStructWithPCtorSerializersRoundTripThroughCodec
methods.description: Tests serialization of external struct records with primary constructors.

methods.name: GeneratedLibExternalRecordWithPCtorSerializersRoundTripThroughCodec
methods.description: Tests serialization of external record types with primary constructors (conditional on NET6_0_OR_GREATER).

methods.name: GeneratedLibExternalGenericRecordStructWithPCtorSerializersRoundTripThroughCodec
methods.description: Tests serialization of external generic struct records with primary constructors (conditional on NET6_0_OR_GREATER).

methods.name: GeneratedReadonlyLibExternalGenericRecordStructWithPCtorSerializersRoundTripThroughCodec
methods.description: Tests serialization of readonly external generic struct records with primary constructors (conditional on NET6_0_OR_GREATER).

methods.name: GeneratedLibExternalGenericRecordWithPCtorSerializersRoundTripThroughCodec
methods.description: Tests serialization of external generic record types with primary constructors (conditional on NET9_0_OR_GREATER).

methods.name: RequiredMembersAreSupported
methods.description: Verifies support for required members in serialization (conditional on NET6_0_OR_GREATER).

methods.name: GeneratedRecordWithExcludedPCtorSerializersRoundTripThroughCodec
methods.description: Tests serialization of records with excluded primary constructor parameters.

methods.name: GeneratedRecordWithExclusiveCtorSerializersRoundTripThroughCodec
methods.description: Tests serialization of records with exclusive constructors.

methods.name: RecordSerializedAsRegularClass
methods.description: Verifies that a record can be serialized as a regular class with identical layout.

methods.name: GeneratedSerializersRoundTripThroughSerializer
methods.description: Serializes and deserializes an object via the serializer, verifying data integrity.

methods.name: GeneratedSerializersRoundTripThroughSerializer_ImmutableClass
methods.description: Tests serialization of immutable class instances.

methods.name: GeneratedSerializersRoundTripThroughSerializer_ImmutableStruct
methods.description: Tests serialization of immutable struct instances.

methods.name: UnmarkedFieldsAreNotSerialized
methods.description: Ensures fields not marked for serialization are not serialized.

methods.name: GenericPocosCanRoundTrip
methods.description: Tests serialization of generic POCOs with type parameters.

methods.name: NestedGenericPocoWithTypeAlias
methods.description: Tests serialization of nested generic POCOs with type aliases.

methods.name: GenericArityAliasTest
methods.description: Tests serialization of generic types with different arities.

methods.name: ArraysAreSupported
methods.description: Verifies support for array serialization.

methods.name: ArraysPocoRoundTrip
methods.description: Tests serialization of POCOs containing multi-dimensional and jagged arrays.

methods.name: MultiDimensionalArraysAreSupported
methods.description: Verifies support for multi-dimensional array serialization.

methods.name: SystemCollectionsRoundTrip
methods.description: Tests serialization of collections like HashSet, ConcurrentQueue, and ConcurrentDictionary.

methods.name: ClassWithLargeCollectionAndUriRoundTrip
methods.description: Tests serialization of classes with large collections and URI properties.

methods.name: ClassWithManualSerializablePropertyRoundTrip
methods.description: Tests serialization of classes with manually serializable properties.

methods.name: ImmutableClassWithImplicitFieldIdsRoundTrip
methods.description: Verifies serialization of classes with implicit field IDs.

methods.name: CopyImmutableAndSealedTypes
methods.description: Tests copying of immutable, mutable, sealed, and unsealed types.

methods.name: DuplicateReferencesSerializeTargetJustOnce
methods.description: Ensures duplicate object references are serialized once with reference preservation.

methods.name: DuplicateReferencesSerializeTargetMultipleTimesWhenSuppressReferenceTrackingEnabled
methods.description: Verifies that reference tracking suppression causes duplicates to serialize separately.

methods.name: DuplicateReferencesToAnyExceptionTypesSerializeTargetMultipleTimes
methods.description: Tests that exceptions are serialized multiple times when shared references are used.

methods.name: DuplicateReferencesToExceptionTypeWithSurrogateSerializeTargetMultipleTimes
methods.description: Tests exception serialization with surrogate types.

methods.name: TypeReferencesAreEncodedOnce
methods.description: Verifies that type references are encoded only once in the stream.

methods.name: TypeCodecDoesNotUpdateTypeReferences
methods.description: Ensures type codecs do not modify type reference tables during serialization.

methods.name: TypeCodecConsumesTypeReferences
methods.description: Verifies that type codecs correctly consume type references during deserialization.

methods.name: TypeDerivedFromList
methods.description: Tests serialization of derived list types.

methods.name: TypeDerivedFromDictionary
methods.description: Tests serialization of derived dictionary types.
